ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hand washing PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hand washing PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Hand washing PRACTICES.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hand washing PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hand washing PRACTICES.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Weather ENVIRONMENT.

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

4. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

5. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for the teeth PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for the teeth PRACTICES.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Foods/Feeding PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants ENVIRONMENT.

9. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying : OUR SCHOOL? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for : OUR SCHOOL.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to : OUR SCHOOL.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on : OUR SCHOOL.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about : OUR SCHOOL.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Producers

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Dressing ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Hand washing PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Care for the teeth PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Sanitation/ PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
